$comment: A flexible body reduced from a finite element mesh (ModalBody3D): the link pose carries the rigid body frame, and a mode-shapes binding deforms the GLB mesh visual of that link by the modal coordinates eta[1..4], one morph target per mode. The second body records its coordinates in mm. The bracket mesh is also coloured by its von Mises stress (heat, 0 to 30 MPa) from the GLB's stress table.
